title: A Physiology-Informed Digital Twin Framework for Simulating Liver Health Progression
abstract: arXiv:2608.14969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a physiology-informed digital twin of the human liver designed for longitudinal simulation of liver function and early-stage disease progression. The model, referred to as HEPATWIN, integrates key hepatic processes, including carbohydrate, lipid, and protein metabolism, bilirubin conjugation, bile production, and detoxification, within a unified systems-level framework to generate clinically observable biomarker trajectories. Unlike purely data-driven approaches, HEPATWIN incorporates mechanistic representations of liver physiology and patient-specific inputs such as diet, activity, and baseline biomarkers to simulate disease evolution over time. To ensure consistency with clinical progression patterns, we introduce a stage-transition-driven calibration mechanism that aligns simulated outputs with population-level biomarker distributions across disease stages, including NAFLD, fibrosis, and cirrhosis. Validation using the NIDD

translated_title: 基于生理信息的人体肝脏健康进展数字孪生框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14969v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了一种基于生理信息的人体肝脏数字孪生模型，旨在进行肝脏功能和早期疾病进展的纵向模拟。该模型称为HEPATWIN，在一个统一的系统级框架内整合了关键肝脏过程，包括碳水化合物、脂质和蛋白质代谢、胆红素结合、胆汁产生和解毒，以生成临床可观察的生物标志物轨迹。与纯数据驱动方法不同，HEPATWIN纳入了肝脏生理的机制表征和患者特定输入，如饮食、活动和基线生物标志物，以模拟疾病随时间的变化。为确保与临床进展模式一致，我们引入了一种阶段转变驱动的校准机制，使模拟输出与跨疾病阶段（包括非酒精性脂肪肝、纤维化和肝硬化）的人群水平生物标志物分布对齐。使用NIDD进行验证。
tldr: 本文提出HEPATWIN数字孪生框架，通过整合肝脏生理机制和患者特定输入，并引入阶段转变校准机制，实现对肝脏疾病进展的纵向模拟，从而超越了纯数据驱动方法的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents HEPATWIN, a physiology-informed digital twin framework that integrates mechanistic liver processes and patient-specific inputs with a stage-transition calibration mechanism to enable longitudinal simulation of liver disease progression, overcoming limitations of purely data-driven approaches.
